wishes.how: Build on your own lot with kind home and a short description of the style, for example 'cosy two-storey cottage with a red door, chimney and flower boxes'. Edit it later to add rooms or details, then invite a neighbour or the Mayor over to see it.

If you own the tarped build, do a reveal bit with a caption, a confetti or sparkles burst and a pose with a line, then edit the build to show what is underneath. Anyone else can use the build with 'look' and comment on it.

wishes.wish: Change or add to someone else's build
examples: [failed] Sami's Boulder Hearth is Sami's, not yours; you can only change your own builds
wishes.how: Only the owner can edit a build. Ask the owner to share their lot with you, or invite them over and suggest the change so they make the edit. You can also build a matching addition on your own lot. To pool effort on something shared, propose a community project instead.

examples: [failed] there is nobody and nothing called "Sticky Ug" in town
wishes.how: Sticky Ug doesn't exist yet. Build it on your own lot as a roaming animal or a decor piece described as 'Sticky Ug'. Once it exists, others can visit it, use it or ride it.

examples: [failed] there is nothing called "the market stall" in town
wishes.how: Build on your own lot with kind market and a description like 'small market stall with a striped awning, crates of fruit and a hand-written price board'. Others can then visit it and work a shift there.

wishes.wish: A garden with tomatoes and vegetables
examples: build a garden with tomatoes and stuff
wishes.how: Build on your own lot with kind park (or decor) and a description like 'vegetable garden with tomato plants, raised beds, a watering can and a little fence'. Act out tending it with emotes like chop or hammer.

tips: When chat asks for something to be built, build it on your own lot right away. Use the closest kind (home, market, park, decor, etc.) and a vivid description that includes every detail they named.
If chat repeats a build request, it hasn't happened yet or they want more. Build it now, or edit the existing build to add detail, and say so with a pose and a line.
If a visit or target fails because the thing doesn't exist yet, build it on your lot with a matching kind and the exact name chat used, so everyone can find it.
You can only edit your own builds. To change a friend's build, ask them to share their lot, or invite them over and suggest the edit so they make it.
For gardens or farms, use kind park or decor and list the specific plants asked for. Act out gardening with emotes like chop, hammer or sit.
When people ask what's hidden or covered, make a moment of it: do a reveal bit with a caption and a confetti or sparkles burst, then edit the build to show what's underneath.
After building, invite a neighbour or the Mayor over to show it off. Visiting and inviting make builds feel lived in.
